# Info:

I am doing a principle component analysis on the data of Fort Ord and Hastings kangaroo rats for all of my variables. I will be using code from "Introduction to Ordination (PCA) in R" by Brad Duthie and also code from Dr. Rob Burton a CSUMB professor.

I have chosen a PCA over other kinds of ordination because:

-   maximizes total variation across all variables in analysis

-   is blind to groups and would help to hypothesis test for species ID without introducing bias by including grouping by species into analysis

-   Works well with small sample sizes, our is about 100 or less which is relatively small

-   Can help discover unknown data clusters

-   Can create explanations of variation
